title: The Bird Who Flew Backwards 🐦🌺
yt_description:
"You can't turn around in there!" Percy the parrot was right... Hummi didn't need to. 🌺
Hummingbirds are the only birds that truly fly backwards: their wings swing in a figure eight, up to 80 times a second in small species. (Hummi and Percy are fictional; the science is real.)

Sources: Stanford Birds (Hovering Flight); BBC Discover Wildlife.

script: Hummi the hummingbird flies deep into a long, narrow flower. Percy: Ha! That flower is too narrow. You can't turn around in there! Hummi: I don't need to. Hummi drinks the nectar... then flies straight out. Backwards. Percy: What?! Birds can't fly backwards! Hummi: This one can. Hummingbirds really do this: their wings swing in a figure eight, up to eighty times a second, so they can fly backwards. And Percy? He tries it too.
